title: Developer-product comparison
command: Compare Neon, Turso, and PlanetScale for a small SQL-backed application. Include features, pricing, limits, source dates, and explicit unknowns.
description: One specialist per product delegates to feature, pricing, and limit researchers.

specialists.goal: Assess this database for a small application needing SQL, migrations, backups, and predictable cost.
